title: Mohammedan SC vs Gokulam Kerala FC Preview: Predicted Lineups, Team News | IFL 2026-27
text:

 Mohammedan SC vs Gokulam Kerala FC Preview: Predicted Lineups, Team News | IFL 2026-27
 By Rohit Mistri Follow Add as Preferred Source A sports journalist passionate about on-ground reporting and football storytelling. Published at : November 20, 2026 at 10:20 AM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : November 20, 2026 at 10:20 AM (GMT+5:30) Kalyani Stadium is set to welcome the Malabarians
 Kalyani Stadium in Kolkata has the permit and has become the official venue of Mohammedan SC for the Indian Football League (IFL) 2026-27 season, and the stadium is now ready to welcome Gokulam Kerala FC in an engaging clash on Friday, 20th November, 2026, from 18:30 IST, where both sides look to control the game as the Black Panthers need to turn their fortune at home. 
 With three wins in three games and nine points, Gokulam Kerala FC are leading the title race; Shillong Lajong and Dempo SC trail behind, but the confidence will be there for the Malabarians as, after three victories, they find themselves at the very top of the summit, while Mohammedan SC, on the other hand, are unable to register their first clinching victory this season following the ISL relegation. 
 The Stakes 
 Catch Every Update, Anytime, Anywhere
 Mohammedan SC 
 Two back-to-back defeats for the Black Panthers in this IFL season after losing out on the ISL 2026-27 spot and being relegated from the top tier to the second tier in Indian football, and after dealing with a lot of dilemmas, the Kolkata outfit still didn’t show that much promise with an all-Indian squad under the guidance of Saheed Raman. 
 At home, they were thrashed by Shillong Lajong in the first game, where the Kolkata-based side were unable to find an equaliser after conceding, leaving them without a point from their first outing of the campaign, and then the Black Panthers also swallowed another loss against FC Bengaluru United. 
 But now this is going to be the clash from which Raman’s side looks to go forward in the best manner to play a good brand of football, or else another setback might haunt their standings. 
 Gokulam Kerala FC 
 A dream run for the Malabarians as they surpass every tricky opponent they have faced till now in this IFL season. With three consecutive victories, the confidence of the team will be sky-high as another test awaits Gokulam Kerala when former ISL side Mohammedan SC seeks a good challenge, which the Kerala side needs to be wary of in an away clash. 
 Against Mohammedan SC, Gokulam Kerala doesn’t yearn for any changes to protect the scorecard or intervene in the game, but they call for some good outputs that Crislan or Aysh Adhikari could make for themselves in the attacking scenarios. With a well-balanced side, the Malabarians are requisite for a great win in the fourth game for them in the IFL’s newest season, where the title charge has been very demanding for every team. 
 Team News
 There is no news of any injury concerns from either side, and both coaches will have a fully fit and available side to pick their best eleven.
 Head-to-head record
 Total Matches Played: 10
 Gokulam Kerala wins: 5
 Mohammedan SC wins: 3
 Draws: 2
 Predicted Lineup
 Mohammedan SC 
 Nikhil Deka (GK), Joseph, Juwel, Dinesh, Hira Mondal, Tangva, Mahitosh Roy, Fardin, Israfil, Sanga, Shiba
 Gokulam Kerala Predicted XI (4-3-3) 
 Shibin Raj Kunniyil (GK); Naresh Singh, Mikel Kortazar, Sarthak Golui, Sachu Siby; Ayush Adhikari, Shighil Nambrath, Lalramsanga; Makan Winkle Chote, Crislan, Victor da Silva
 Telecast details
 Mohammedan SC will host Gokulam Kerala FC at the Kalyani Stadium in Kolkata on Friday, November 20th, 2026.
 The match is scheduled to kick off at 6:30 PM IST, as both sides will aim for a win in this game to gain momentum from the initial rounds.
 The match and the rest of the IFL 2026-27 season will be broadcast live on DD Sports, with live streaming on Waves OTT, Zee5, and Unite8 Sports YouTube channels.
